diagnosis: The trading order execution subscription connects to Redis pub/sub channels based directly on input.accountId. While it checks for an authenticated session, it does not confirm that the authenticated user owns or has trading authority over the requested trading account. Any authenticated user can eavesdrop in real time on proprietary trade fills, target limit orders, and execution prices of competing trading firms.
